key_insight: DFT-trained machine-learning force fields can simulate the martensitic transformation in Ni2MnGa with near-ab initio fidelity, capturing soft phonons and nanotwinned martensite behavior at finite temperature.
engineering_relevance: This enables large-scale, longer-time simulations of magnetic shape-memory alloys, supporting faster design of materials with improved transformation control and actuator performance.
method: Train ML force fields on DFT-based ab initio molecular dynamics data
Run classical molecular dynamics to model austenite-martensite transformation dynamics
Analyze phonon softening, twin-boundary energetics, and adaptive nanotwinning
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that the ML-FF reproduces the key DFT features of Ni2MnGa, including the TA2 soft mode and a preference for nanotwinned martensites.
watch_item: Accuracy depends on how well the training data covers relevant transformation pathways, especially under finite-temperature and highly distorted local environments.
paper_title: Modelling the dynamics of the martensitic transformation in Ni$_2$MnGa with machine-learning force-fields
